> I like the feature but I am unsure about instant API option. The library is called "instantsearch" but we have an option to disable the "instant": it was my first reaction.

Any idea what could be a better naming? `searchAsYouType: true/false` was not nice :/

> Along with this option we would need a submit button to be generated (as an option too), because otherwise it makes sense only on desktop

Hmmm, it is the goal responsibility of the searchbox? Because having a submit button means you have a wrapping `<form>` as well. Good point but not sure how to fix it :/
